items.text: The game is not currently playable in its current condition, the graphical overlay on most starting pods can cause a game breaking bug where you can not click on actual ship parts. Seeing wires on your ship is realistic, but the poor graphics make it laughable to distinguish between certain parts. There is no actual tutorial to explain anything, and the written notes for instructions on how to fly the ship is not inclusive for different eye sights abilities. One the game tells you to "open your inventory and check what you have" and "pilot the ship" and the next you die of no O2 without explaining what went wrong. I cant get my money back  sadly, so I caution you to not waste yours on this.
items.text_zh: 游戏目前的状态下无法游玩，大多数起始舱的图形叠加层会导致一个破坏游戏的bug，让你无法点击实际的飞船部件。在你的飞船上看到电线很真实，但糟糕的画面让区分某些部件变得可笑。没有任何实际教程来解释任何东西，而关于如何驾驶飞船的书面说明对于不同视力能力的人来说并不包容。一会儿游戏告诉你“打开你的物品栏，检查你有什么”和“驾驶飞船”，下一刻你就因为没有氧气而死亡，却没有解释出了什么问题。遗憾的是我拿不回我的钱了，所以我提醒你不要把你的钱浪费在这上面。
